2.3 Properties of TASEP and the oriented swap process

Our analysis of the oriented swap process relies on its connection with TASEP. In this section, we present some propositions about TASEP and how they relate to the oriented swap process. Firstly. we define certain operations on configurations of TASEP or the oriented swap process. A configuration p € Z' specifies the type of particle at each position and the set of all such configurations is denoted as S.
